about: Definitions every renderer must take alike (ADR 003): the web page (test/figure.test.js), Android (FigureTest.kt) and the Mac (FigureTests.swift) each put a case's state into lib/figure.json as the state "extra" and read it. accepted: the definition is used; moves: the state then has a movement. Written as text, not built in code, so that 0.0 and 1e0 reach each reader as they stand.

cases.what: a movement given as false is no movement
a movement given as 0 is no movement
a movement given as 0.0 is no movement
a movement given as -0 is no movement
a movement given as "" is no movement
a movement given as null is no movement
a movement given as true is refused
a movement given as a word is refused
a movement given as a number is refused
a movement given as a list is refused
a pose given as an empty list says nothing
a pose given as a list with something in it is refused
a pose given as null is refused
a layer given as an empty list is refused
a layer given as a list is refused
a layer given as a list in a key is refused
the first and last keys are compared as numbers: 0 and 0.0
the first and last keys are compared as numbers: 1 and 1e0, 0.5 and 5e-1
the first and last keys are compared as numbers: 0 and -0
the first and last keys may name a layer's values in another order
first and last keys that differ as numbers are refused
